clips.title: The story
paras: At the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar, Innkeeper Gryshka welcomes travelers with food, drink, and a hearthstone binding. She keeps the inn supplied with meat from hunters across Durotar and the Barrens.

Innkeeper Gryshka welcomes travelers at the Broken Tusk in Orgrimmar's Valley of Strength. The inn stands just beyond the city's main gates, where warriors, messengers, and newcomers to Thrall's Horde can find shelter.

Gryshka keeps the Broken Tusk's kitchen supplied with fresh meat. Trusted hunters across Horde lands send her game, including Zargh at the Crossroads and Grimtak in Durotar, who ship their finest cuts to the inn.
